journalPosts.title: Why Chiffon, Lace, and Silk
journalPosts.label: Materials
journalPosts.excerpt: A short note on the materials that shape the direction of Designs by Brooke.
journalPosts.body:
The foundation of Designs by Brooke begins with three materials: chiffon, lace, and silk.

Chiffon brings movement and softness. Lace adds texture, pattern, and delicate detail. Silk creates a smooth, elevated finish.

Together, these materials shape the portfolio’s soft neutral direction and help define the visual language of the brand.

journalPosts.title: Soft Neutrals as a Design Base
journalPosts.label: Palette
journalPosts.excerpt: How light grey, pearl beige, stone, taupe, and driftwood create a softer design language.
journalPosts.body:
Soft neutrals create a calm foundation for the Designs by Brooke portfolio.

Light grey, pearl beige, stone, taupe, and driftwood allow texture and material choices to stand out without overwhelming the design.

This palette supports a softer visual language while still feeling modern, intentional, and polished.

journalPosts.title: Building a Fashion Portfolio
journalPosts.label: Process
journalPosts.excerpt: A look at sketches, mood boards, material studies, and styling concepts as the portfolio grows.
journalPosts.body:
A fashion portfolio grows through process, not just finished work.

Sketches, mood boards, material studies, garment details, and styling concepts all show how an idea develops over time.

Designs by Brooke will continue to build around texture, soft neutrals, and material-led creative direction.
